scope: Repairs of two pre-existing test harness failures; no gameplay or world changes

before.worldFailure: The test expected three routes; all eight unchanged worlds already register four valid routes

repairs.guardian: The save probe bundles makeGameState, captureCheckpoint and restoreCheckpoint with their real production dependencies. It starts from the real factory, removes legacy optional fields and still verifies both retry/resume stale-lock removal, input immutability and preservation of a living boss field.
repairs.worlds: The test explicitly requires four routes with distinct identities and the authored canopy-transfer route. Existing geometry validation, physical feature completeness, safe extraction lane, hazard overlap and surface coverage constraints remain.

additionalFixtureCorrection.change: Replaced invalid wolf-raider fixture ID with the actual catalogue ID wolf-ship; no runtime change
